modules.name: Anti-tamper loader — lib__7ffe__.so
modules.note: ALL 4 module blobs decrypted+patch-merged (0x11b4/0x3188 chain). data1.dat: exhaustively ruled out for the loader crypto - dd70 with ANY 32-bit seed (vectorized sweep + tiling oracle), outer format, stage-1 self-keyed, stream/CBC orders, AES with shipped key, zlib - all fail. e2 blob (969KB, device 0xf3) is its structural twin ([4B][16-aligned], ent 8.0): shared GAME-SIDE scheme in libgame.so. Device registry protocol reversed (e1+0xe678/e688/e694, {id,ptr,size}x0x100) = the game's entry point into the protector. Seed global [0x257e8] never written - stays 0x14B4. M2: libgame.so consumer + key derivation
